senses.gloss: חֵרֵשׁ, חֵי׳ (denom. of חֵרֵשׁ) to deafen, make deaf.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 86a:3">B. Kam. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>שחֵירְשׁוֹ וכ׳</he> when he made him deaf without wounding him.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 86a:3">Ib.</cite> <he>החוֹרֵשׁ את אביו</he> (Ms. H. a. R. <cite ref="H01784"><he>חֵרֵשׁ</he></cite>); <cite ref="Bava Kamma 98a:7">ib. 98ᵃ</cite> <he>חֵרְשׁוֹ לאביו</he> if one injured his father’s hearing; v. <cite ref="H01701"><he>חֲרִישָׁה</he> II</cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 109a:1">Sabb. 109ᵃ</cite> top. <he>יד מְחָרֶשֶׁת</he> the unwashed hand put to the ear causes deafness.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 86a">B. Kam. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>להַחֲרִישׁ</he>, v. <cite ref="H01701"><he>חֲרִישָׁה</he> II</cite>.

senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be silent. Y. Pes. IX, end. 37ᵃ (ref. to Prov. XVII, 28) ואין צ״ל חכם מַחֲרִישׁ and it is needless to say the same of a wise man keeping silence. [Usu. שָׁתַק.]

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 14:1">Yeb. XIV, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 1:1">Tosef. Ter. I, 1</cite> <he>פיקח ונ׳</he> if he had been well-hearing and became etc.; v. <cite ref="H01784"><he>חֵרֵשׁ</he></cite>.
